title: Project docs sync
description: Project document registry sync at phase close: the verifier answers the two docs-sync control questions against the project document registry and records per-document outcomes in a Docs sync section of VERIFICATION.md.

workflow.docs_sync.description: At verify:post, instruct the verifier to sync project documents against the project document registry (canonically .planning/PROJECT-DOCS.md, or the project's own document index): answer the two control questions (did the phase change the operational surface; which cross-cutting topic did it work through), then record one line per touched registry document in a '## Docs sync' section of VERIFICATION.md — 'updated (commit X)' or 'not required (reason)'. The registry is an open list: a new cross-cutting topic means creating the document AND appending a registry row in the same commit. The step is advisory at the workflow level (onError: continue); the 'phase is not closed without Docs sync' enforcement stays a project-process rule carried by the step text.
